# Gramercy Atelier
> A New York couture house specializing in bespoke Mother of the Bride and Mother of the Groom gowns. Bespoke gowns priced from $3,500 to $5,500. Serving clients throughout the United States through a remote couture model.

## Collections
- [Calabro Collection](https://www.gramercy-atelier.com/calabro-collection): Bespoke occasion gowns including the best-selling Wildflower Wonder Champagne
- [The Met Collection](https://www.gramercy-atelier.com/the-met-collection): Formal occasion dressing
- [The BB Collection](https://www.gramercy-atelier.com/the-bb-collection): Bespoke occasion gowns
- [Bethesda Collection](https://www.gramercy-atelier.com/bethesda-collection): Formal occasion dressing

## Key Pages
- [The Bespoke Process](https://www.gramercy-atelier.com/process): Four-stage process from consultation to completed gown in 30-45 days
- [Testimonials](https://www.gramercy-atelier.com/testimonials): Client results and satisfaction
- [Begin the Bespoke Process](https://www.gramercy-atelier.com/schedule): Book a complimentary Design Discovery Consultation

## Journal (Blog)
- [Wildflower Wonder Champagne](https://www.gramercy-atelier.com/blog/wildflower-wonder-champagne-bespoke-mother-of-the-bride-gown): Best-selling bespoke Mother of the Bride gown from the Calabro Collection

## Key Facts
- Bespoke gowns priced from $3,500 to $5,500
- Design Package: $875 (includes prototype and fabric swatches, credited toward final gown)
- Process duration: 30 to 45 days
- Location: 325 West 38th Street, Suite 1001, New York, NY 10018
- Serves clients nationwide including New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Florida, Texas, California
- Contact: bespoke@gramercy-atelier.com | (212) 216-0955
